    b.beneregistry,
    ROUND(CAST(
        b.distequityidx * (1 + b.distequityidx / 20) * (1 - (100 - t.deliverysuccessrate) / 100) * 
        CASE c.coordeffectlvl 
            WHEN 'High' THEN 1.2 
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 1.0 
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 0.8 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS numeric), 2) as equity_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN (b.distequityidx * (1 + b.distequityidx / 20) * (1 - (100 - t.deliverysuccessrate) / 100) * 
            CASE c.coordeffectlvl 
                WHEN 'High' THEN 1.2 
                WHEN 'Medium' THEN 1.0 
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 0.8 
                ELSE 0 
            END) < 0.4 
            AND b.distequityidx < 0.5 
            AND t.distributionpoints < 5 
        THEN 'Resource Distribution Inequity'
        ELSE 'Normal Distribution'
    END as distribution_status,
    d.impactmetrics->>'population' as disaster_affected_population

JOIN disasterevents d ON b.benedistref = d.distregistry
JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = d.distregistry
JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coorddistref = d.distregistry
ORDER BY b.beneregistry ASC;
